extraction.notes: Q4 2024 (three months ended 12/31/2024) column only. Company reports no AFFO metric; affo fields null. Core FFO is the company's name for the adjusted FFO measure. Subtotals check: -5,079 -900 +27,640 -79 -24 = 21,558; 21,558 +2,171 +171 +417 -454 = 23,863. Diluted shares 19,839 reproduces $1.09 (21,718/19,839) and $1.21 (24,023/19,839), where the diluted numerators add back $160 Series D preferred dividends. The 'Depreciation and amortization' line is total D&A (including non-real estate); it is categorized as re_depreciation and the non-real-estate and JV portions are removed on the following lines. Swap amortization is categorized as debt_cost_amortization (judgment call). 'Other miscellaneous items' (-454) is (gain) loss on investments plus one-time professional fees, so it is categorized as other. Zero-value lines (impairment, gain on sale, severance, litigation, preferred redemption) are included at 0 as printed as dashes. Recurring capex: the AFFO section does not subtract it; the only disclosure is the same-store per-home figure of $238 (per apartment home, not a company total), entered with basis per_unit_only.
